# E. Opportunities & Solutions

**Purpose:** Decide how to deliver the target architecture: work packages, build vs. buy,
dependencies.

## Outputs
- Work packages (epics, milestones)
- Build / reuse decisions (as ADRs)
- Dependencies between tasks

## Content
In the factory, the conductor splits approved stories into **task** issues, each with a complexity
label and "blocked by" links. Larger build-vs-buy choices become ADRs.
